description: Hampshire County Council corpus is the Wayback harvest (partial months 2016-17 to 2024-25, site bot-walled). Purchase card rows carry type purchase_card. The council's own redaction label for direct payments appears as the supplier string 'Adult Services'. Default is procurement_paid.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions for direct payments to individuals (foster carers, ASC direct payments). Lawfully unnamed.
NHS Integrated Care Board rows are statutory health funding pass-through, not council procurement.
Hampshire's published redaction labels for payments to individuals (PERSONAL PAYMENTS dominates the feed at ~32k rows; Adult Services/Children's Services appear in older files); not suppliers.
LGPS flows to the Hampshire Pension Fund (HCC is the administering authority) are internal, not procurement.
